Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the petitioner in a child welfare case to provide the court with relevant documentation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to documentation in child welfare proceedings; andadding a new section to chapter 13.34 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 13.34 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In any proceeding under this chapter, if the petitioner submits areport containing any recommendations, opinions, evaluations, orassertions to the court, the petitioner must provide the court withdocumentation relating to the recommendation, opinion, evaluation, orassertion, that is available to the petitioner and of which thepetitioner is aware, including but not limited to psychologicalevaluations, service reports, visitation reports, foster parentreports, medical reports, and other reports relevant to that particularcourt hearing. A summary prepared by the petitioner is insufficient ifnot supported by available documentation. A summary of such a reportis sufficient if the summary is prepared by the provider and is not asummary of the provider report prepared by the petitioner.
